title: Custom frontmatter (extension seam)
$comment: promptless.ai-specific frontmatter requirements go here, so docmeta.config.yaml never needs to change. This repo requires every docs page to carry both `title` and `description`: `title` is also required by the Starlight mirror, and `description` is required only here (Starlight treats it as optional) so a page missing it fails docmeta in CI rather than shipping without an HTML meta description / OG card. To add another repo-specific required field (e.g. `owner`), add it to "required" and describe it under "properties". If you extend Astro's zod schema in src/content.config.ts (docsSchema({ extend })), mirror the same fields here so violations fail in CI, not at build time.

title.description: The title of the current page. Required on every docs page.

description.description: Short summary used in the page's HTML <meta> description and social/OG preview card. Required on every docs page; 150-160 characters recommended.
